description: The designed audiobook voices and styles of the multi-speaker, multi-style model - the design record (each voice's archetype and genres) of lib/synthesis.js's voice and style tables, which speak them (test/testSynthesis.js checks that the tables match it). A voice is a blend of the speaker table's American readers (blend - speaker keys of the manifest's speakers and weights summing to 1), with mild interpretable adjustments of the parameter frames (adjust - pitchScale, tractScale, effort in dB; lib/transforms.js) and a default speaking rate (rate - the speed, 1 is the model's own). A style applies the model's style embedding (model - an emotion and intensity), parameter transforms (transform - applied after the voice's), and a rate (multiplying the voice's); neutral applies none.

voices.name: Sarah
voices.description: A warm, unhurried storyteller with a mid-low, rounded tone - an easy companion for a long novel.

voices.name: Helen
voices.description: A mature, composed voice, lower and slower, with quiet authority for weighty books.

voices.name: Amy
voices.description: A young, bright, lively voice, higher and quicker, for younger readers and light-hearted stories.

voices.name: Kate
voices.description: A brisk, clear, articulate voice with a crisp tone that keeps facts and arguments moving.

voices.name: Grace
voices.description: A gentle, soft, slow voice with a dark, quiet tone for winding down.

voices.name: James
voices.description: A warm, relaxed storyteller with a mid-low, rounded tone for long-form fiction.

voices.name: Robert
voices.description: A mature, deep, deliberate voice with a grave authority for serious and older books.

voices.name: Michael
voices.description: A young, bright, energetic voice, higher and quicker, for younger readers and adventure.

voices.name: David
voices.description: A brisk, clear, matter-of-fact voice with a crisp tone for explanation and reportage.

voices.name: Thomas
voices.description: A gentle, soft, slow voice with a dark, calm tone for poetry and quiet evenings.

styles.label: Neutral
styles.description: The voice as designed - plain narration.

styles.label: Angry
styles.description: A pressed, raised, louder voice - angry without the angry embedding, which sounded muffled.

styles.label: Happy
styles.description: The happy style embedding, a little brighter, higher, and louder.

styles.label: Sad
styles.description: The sad style embedding (lower, slower, and darker).

styles.label: Fearful
styles.description: The fearful style embedding, a little breathy, higher, and quicker.

styles.label: Disgusted / contemptuous
styles.description: The disgusted style embedding, a little pressed, lower, and slower.

styles.label: Soft
styles.description: A quieter voice, a little slower.

styles.label: Shouting
styles.description: A pressed, bright, raised voice, a little louder - its consonants with it.

styles.label: Dialogue
styles.description: Neutral dialogue - a little higher, brighter, and quicker than the narration (style auto's quotations).

styles.label: Exclaim
styles.description: An exclamation - the dialogue style livelier: louder, wider in pitch, and quicker (style auto's exclaimed quotations).
